messages:
fergie_csm: Heads-up: Aurora tenant goes live 10:00 PT tomorrow. I sketched a short health-loop runbook focused on prefill, lightweight warm caches, and renewal signal capture. Please skim + ack.

nate_sre: Ack. Ops TL;DR: prefill cache with top 20 prompts, warm KV with cache_ttl=40s. Ramp: 0->25% traffic (15m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% (1h). Start batching off for first 10m, then batch_size=3, window_ms=200. If p50 > 350ms after a ramp step, revert to previous step and set batch_size=1.

carmen_te: Runtime flags we'll expose to CSM via tenant toggle: enable_streaming=true, batch_size=3, batch_window_ms=200, cache_ttl_seconds=40. Small CLI smoke: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"aurora-v1","stream":true,"input":"ping"}' | jq .stream_open
```
Expect true. Also script will write and read 5 sample keys under kv/aurora/$TENANT to verify cache warmup.

drew_pm: Renewal-metrics to track: day-7 retention, avg_error_rate, and first-week DAU. Rule: if day-7 retention < 12% AND avg_error_rate > 1.5% for 6h -> create renewal_watch and CSM outreach in 12h. Add feedback capture: include 1-question survey in kickoff email about latency/accuracy impressions.

fergie_csm: I'll send the kickoff email with the 1-question poll and expected volume table. I'll also post a checklist for CSMs: confirm API keys, run streaming smoke, verify cache warmup, note any fallback model usage.

nate_sre: On-call quick actions for backpressure: 1) disable streaming 2) batch_size=1 3) enable fallback_model=aurora-lite 4) if p95 > 1s for >10m, escalate. I'll add to eng-oncall.

health-bot: monitor: aurora.* p50_latency, p95_latency, error_rate, token_usage rolled up hourly. Alerts configured for p95>900ms or error_rate>1.5%.

fergie_csm: Thanks team. Action items: fergie send kickoff email + poll, carmen add CLI warmup script, nate add on-call steps, drew add renewal_watch rule. I'll monitor first 36h and post updates here. :rocket:
